family: MiVOLO V2 age and gender estimator
weights_license: Apache-2.0 per Hugging Face model card
training_data_lineage: Model card states proprietary and open-source datasets; exact dataset mix is not fully enumerated.
input_profile: paired 384x384 face/person RGB tensors; normalized with ImageNet mean/std; missing face uses normalized zero input
runtime_profile: local Transformers model; loaded once by odc.age.MiVOLOV2AgeEstimator; CPU/CUDA/MPS selection

score_semantics.age_output: regressed apparent-age point estimate, not a class probability
